## `LazyListState` { #lazyliststate-sealed-class }

`public sealed class LazyListState`

Persistent state for a virtualized lazy list. Applications only need to keep an instance when they want to observe or control scrolling; `LazyColumn(items)` and `LazyRow(items)` create and retain one automatically.

**Constructeurs**

| Membre | Description |
|---|---|
| `LazyListState()` |  |

**Propriétés**

| Membre | Description |
|---|---|
| `bool IsScrollable { get; }` | Whether the measured or estimated content exceeds the viewport. |
| `bool UserScrollEnabled { get; set; }` | When false, touch gestures do not scroll this list. |
| `float CurrentOffset { get; }` | Current logical scroll offset. Zero is the start of the list. |
| `float FirstVisibleItemScrollOffset { get; }` | Logical offset inside `FirstVisibleItemIndex`. |
| `int CurrentPage { get; }` | Page a pager rests on or is settling on (see `VerticalPager`). |
| `int FirstVisibleItemIndex { get; }` | Index of the first item intersecting the viewport. |

## `NavigationBars` { #navigationbars-static-class }

`public static class NavigationBars`

Ready-made bottom bars for `BottomBar`.

**Méthodes**

| Membre | Description |
|---|---|
| `static XenoComponent Docked(NavigationPresentationContext context, DockedNavigationBarStyle style = null, NavigationAction action = null)` | A bottom bar with an optional docked action button. The button sits in its own slot of the row (`CenterActionPosition`, the middle of the shown destinations by default), rises above the bar and is seated in a cradle cut out of the bar. The bar follows the reading direction: in right-to-left the first destination is on the right. Content is inset by the bar only; the raised button overlaps it. |

## `OverlayAnimation` { #overlayanimation-sealed-class }

`public sealed class OverlayAnimation`

Describes the enter and exit animation of an overlay panel. The scrim always fades with the same progress. Instances are immutable: `With…` returns a copy.

```csharp
OverlayAnimation.SlideUp(320).WithFade().WithEasing(NavEasing.Emphasized)
OverlayAnimation.Custom(NavTransition.Create()
    .Enter(x => x.Opacity(0, 1).Scale(0.6f, 1)).Exit(x => x.Opacity(1, 0)).Duration(250).Build())
```

```csharp
Application.Overlays.Show(() => Text("Saved").Padding(16).Background(0xFF323232),
    new OverlayOptions { Placement = OverlayPlacement.Bottom, Modal = false,
        AutoDismiss = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(3), Animation = OverlayAnimation.SlideUp() });
```

The builder runs inside a composition scope, so any `Compose` factory works. Callable from any thread; the overlay appears on the next frame. |
| `OverlayHandle Show(Func<XenoComponent> content, OverlayOptions options = null)` | Composes `content` into a new overlay and animates it in. The builder runs inside a composition scope, so any `Compose` factory works. Callable from any thread; the overlay appears on the next frame. |

## `OverlayMotion` { #overlaymotion-enum }

`public enum OverlayMotion`

How an overlay's panel moves while it appears and disappears.

| Valeur | Description |
|---|---|
| `None` | The panel appears and disappears instantly. |
| `Fade` | Opacity only. |
| `Scale` | Grows from `ScaleFrom` to full size while fading. |
| `SlideUp` | Rises from below the screen edge (bottom sheets, snackbars). |
| `SlideDown` | Drops from above the screen edge (top banners). |
| `SlideStart` | Enters from the leading edge (left in left-to-right). |
| `SlideEnd` | Enters from the trailing edge. |
| `Custom` | Driven by a `NavTransition` (translation in dp). |

## `ScrollState` { #scrollstate-class }

`public class ScrollState`

Holds scroll offset, velocity, and viewport metadata for a scrollable container. Lives in page fields — survives Rebuild() because page instances are reused.

Zero-GC: allocated once at page construction, mutated in-place forever. No per-frame allocation. InputSystem writes Offset/Velocity, LayoutSystem writes ContentHeight/ViewportHeight, RenderSystem reads Offset for canvas.Translate().



```csharp
// Page field — created once, reused across Rebuild()
private readonly ScrollState _scroll = new();

// In Body():
LazyColumn(_scroll, items.Length, i => ItemRow(i))
```

**Constructeurs**

| Membre | Description |
|---|---|
| `ScrollState()` |  |

**Propriétés**

| Membre | Description |
|---|---|
| `bool IsScrollable { get; }` | True if content is taller/wider than the viewport. |
| `bool UserScrollEnabled { get; set; }` | When false, touch gestures no longer scroll this container (for example a pager under an open bottom sheet). Programmatic scrolling still works. |
| `float CurrentOffset { get; }` | Current scroll offset in dp. 0 = top/left. |
| `float MaxOffset { get; }` | Legacy name for `MinOffset`. |
| `float MinOffset { get; }` | Furthest valid offset toward the end (always negative or zero). |
| `int CurrentPage { get; }` | Page the pager rests on, or is settling on after a gesture. |

**Méthodes**

| Membre | Description |
|---|---|
| `void ScrollToPage(int page)` | Jumps a pager to `page` on the next frame. Safe to call from the UI thread; the frame applies it once the viewport is known. |

**Événements**

| Membre | Description |
|---|---|
| `event Action<int> PageChanged` | Raised on the UI thread when a gesture (or `ScrollToPage`) moves the pager to another page; raised at release, not after the settle animation. |

## `XenoApp` { #xenoapp-abstract-class }

`public abstract class XenoApp`

Application root, persistent page registry and navigation coordinator.

**Propriétés**

| Membre | Description |
|---|---|
| `NativeTunnel Native { get; }` |  |
| `OverlayHost Overlays { get; }` | Dialogs, sheets, snackbars and popups drawn above the page and the navigation chrome. Prefer the ready-made widgets (`Snackbar`, `Alert`, `BottomSheet`…); use this to show any component as an overlay. |
| `XenoPage ActivePage { get; }` |  |
| `bool CanGoBack { get; }` |  |
| `bool IsPreview { get; }` | True when this instance only hosts design-time previews (Visual Studio "XenoUI Preview"): it was constructed, `OnStart` never ran, there is no engine, navigation or device, and native services are stand-ins. Test it to skip network or other side effects in code previews reach. |
| `bool IsRightToLeft { get; }` | The direction scenes are laid out with once `FlowDirection` is resolved. |
| `byte FlowDirection { get; set; }` | Reading direction of every scene. `Inherit` (the default) follows the device locale through `ILayoutDirectionCapability`, and is left-to-right on hosts that do not report one. Subtrees can still override it with `.FlowDirection(...)`. |

## `XenoAppDiscovery` { #xenoappdiscovery-static-class }

`public static class XenoAppDiscovery`

Discovers the developer's XenoApp subclass at startup via reflection. Scans all loaded assemblies for a concrete class inheriting XenoApp. One-time cost at boot — not per-frame.

**Méthodes**

| Membre | Description |
|---|---|
| `static XenoApp Find()` | Finds and instantiates the first concrete XenoApp subclass. Throws if none found or if multiple are found. |

## `XenoShape` { #xenoshape-abstract-class }

`public abstract class XenoShape`

Custom outline of an entity. It replaces the rounded rectangle for the background fill, the shadow, the clip applied to children and the touch area. Assign it with `.Shape(...)`; `.CornerRadius(...)` is ignored on an entity that has a shape.

The outline is built in logical units with its origin at the entity's top-left corner, and only when the entity's size changes: stable frames reuse the cached path. A shape instance can be shared by entities of any size.

**Méthodes**

| Membre | Description |
|---|---|
| `static XenoShape Create(Action<SKPath, float, float> build)` | A shape from a path builder: `(path, width, height) => ...`. |

## `XenoShapes` { #xenoshapes-static-class }

`public static class XenoShapes`

Built-in outlines.

**Méthodes**

| Membre | Description |
|---|---|
| `static XenoShape TopNotch(float notchRadius, float notchCenterY = 0, float notchCenterX = 0.5, float shoulderRadius = 8, float topCornerRadius = 0, float bottomCornerRadius = 0)` | A bar whose top edge is cut by a circular cradle, the classic seat of a docked floating action button. The cradle's circle has radius `notchRadius`; its centre sits `notchCenterY` below the top edge (negative: above it) at `notchCenterX` of the width, measured from the left. Its shoulders are rounded with `shoulderRadius`. A notch that does not reach the bar leaves a plain rounded rectangle. |
